subject.title: OAuth 401 regression: oauth-2025-04-20 beta not injected when context1m set via model headers

question: Should maintainers adopt/retarget the open fork PR, or close that candidate and sponsor a narrow same-repository fix in the current direct Anthropic transport path?
rationale: The bug is high-confidence from source, but an open fork PR already uses closing syntax while the same-repository attempt was closed unmerged after proof and active-path concerns; automation should not queue a competing fix without a routing decision.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow current-main fix
options.body: Close or ignore the stale fork candidate and land a focused same-repository patch in `src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.ts` plus regression tests for direct Anthropic OAuth with model-level beta headers.

options.title: Adopt and retarget the fork PR
options.body: Ask a maintainer to bring the fork change into the main repository, retarget it to the active direct transport path, and require focused proof before merge.

options.title: Pause behind the fork candidate
options.body: Leave this issue open with no new repair lane until the fork author or a maintainer updates the closing PR into a viable landing path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow current-main fix
recommendation.body: Close or ignore the stale fork candidate and land a focused same-repository patch in `src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.ts` plus regression tests for direct Anthropic OAuth with model-level beta headers.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest history on the direct Anthropic transport and endpoint-classification path where the repair likely belongs.
